title: Yu-Gi-Oh Metal Detector PSV-022 1st Ed Pharaoh's Servant - LP
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Slight crease. See pics.

This is a rare and valuable Metal Detector card from the Pharaoh's Servant set of the YuGiOh game. It features the character of Metal Detector and the card number PSV-022, making it a must-have for any collector of CCG individual cards. This card is a 1st Edition and is sure to impress any YuGiOh enthusiast.

The Metal Detector card is perfect for those who love the YuGiOh game and are looking to expand their collection. It is an excellent addition to any set and will make a great gift for a fellow YuGiOh player. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and unique card.
